data.name: Little Farm Island
data.detailed_description:
Farming, Exploration, Survival, and Memes (Scroll down for more!)

  • Forget those perfect farm games where everything always goes smoothly. Welcome to Little Farm Island, where country life might seem tranquil, but it's always playing tricks on you! Sure, you'll build your dream farm, but you land here like a tourist.

Build Your Farm (And don't expect it to be easy!)

You'll build your farm from scratch, and with some luck, you'll harvest the fruits (and veggies, of course!) of your hard work. If you've got some spare cash, invest in pumpkin seeds. Taking care of them is like having a kid: a kid that gives you pumpkins. But it's worth it, because these beauties will come in handy for filling your belly later. Don't think it's just about planting and waiting; here, you've got to get your hands dirty!

Alcohol: Drink Responsibly (Or the consequences are hilarious!)

Think twice before drowning yourself in wine, beer, or other drinks! Alcohol can turn you into a zombie in record time, leading you to a state of drunkenness that's straight out of a comedy movie. A drunk character means losing control, making blunder after blunder, and being a walking mess around the island until the buzz wears off. The gameplay? Well, let's just say it can become... challenging. And yes, you'll get some good laughs, but at your character's expense.

Watch Out for Road Blunders and Other Accidents

The island roads? Dangerously crazy! Pay close attention to traffic. Getting run over by a car here isn't like in those cartoons where you just bounce back. This has a serious impact on your health and can send you straight to the nearest hospital. Remember, road safety is crucial so you don't end up flat on your back, seeing stars!

The Freedom to Play (Even if that means dumpster diving)

Hunger is a beast and can lead you to desperate measures, like rummaging through trash or eating wild plants. Here, it's the law of the jungle! But a warning: not all plants on the island are your friends. Some are poisonous! So, be careful what you put in your mouth. It's what you do to survive, but with a touch of caution and a good dose of dark humor.

Island Folks with Unique Stories and Vibrant Personalities

Get closer to the island's inhabitants and see what you can dig up. Optional missions might reward you with clothes, food, and some handy items for survival. The choice is yours, and so are the rewards. Here, we interact, and believe me, some of these characters are something else!

Scary Missions and Hidden Secrets: The Story Begins!

The story is hidden in mysterious missions and much more. As you explore, you might stumble upon strange signs that trigger unsettling events. Like a devil suddenly appearing to chase you, only to vanish moments later. These are just glimpses of the deeper mysteries that await those brave enough to seek them out. The island has its own secrets... and ghosts.

Start Your Adventure Today!

Arrive as a tourist and immediately embrace the freedom to forge your own path on the captivating island of Woodisland.

  • Open World Freedom: Explore every corner of a super diverse open world, from cities to wild and peaceful nature. The island is your playground: go wherever you want, whenever you want.

  • Customization and Creativity: Create your unique island life! Choose any skin for your character, design your dream home with custom furniture, and build the farm you've always imagined.

  • Almost Real Brands: You'll see brands that will make you laugh out loud, like laughing at real-life stuff, but all in a fictional way.

  • Survival Challenges: Will you thrive or just survive? Test your skills in managing resources like food, water, and health as you overcome unexpected challenges and the island's natural dangers. No easy ride here!

  • Drivable Vehicle: Explore at your own pace, or hit the gas! Your drivable vehicle allows you to quickly traverse the island and discover even more hidden treasures.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Lose yourself in the island's tranquil atmosphere, surrounded by calming nature sounds and the simple joys of a unique, mystical world. Your progress is safe!

And, of course, get ready to interact with some silly things the island hides, because life isn't just about work, right? Fun is guaranteed, even if it's just laughing at your own screw-ups!

               

The game features a save/load system. All your items, money, and character skins are saved and restored when you load your game. (Just a small detail: you'll need to quickly re-equip your skin after loading, as the character defaults to white/genderless with each load.)

As an indie developer from Portugal in Early Access, player feedback is incredibly important to me. Thank you for your support and for helping to shape the future of Little Farm Island!

data.short_description: Ditch boring farm life! Little Farm Island packs farming, exploration, dumpster diving, and gritty survival. Expect weird characters, mysterious secrets, drunkenness, and enough facepalm moments for your meme gallery. Get ready for a wild, messy, hilarious ride!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.0 GHz (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU supporting DirectX 9.0c (minimum 512 MB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for modern systems with better performance at higher resolutions and advanced settings.
